forum.title: vscode for stm32cubeide debug with jlink
forum.best_answer_content:
​@杜明恢

Live Watch variables are not yet supported for Segger J-Link. This feature is part of the roadmap, but no release date is available at this time.

See [When using Jlink Debug in STM32CubeIDE for Visual Studio Code, liveWatch cannot be used | Community](https://community.st.com/stm32cubeide-for-visual-studio-code-mcus-133/when-using-jlink-debug-in-stm32cubeide-for-visual-studio-code-livewatch-cannot-be-used-167304)
